title: Astro Portal API v1 service identity
description: The body of the public GET /v1/service route: a fixed marker, the integer API version, the software version and, since the space sign-in, how a person signs in to this service. No credential, no database read, nothing sensitive. Clients call it to check that an address really is an Astro portal speaking a compatible API version before saving it, to tell whether the configured service answers, and to choose the sign-in screen. Additional properties may appear in later versions and must be ignored by clients.

signIn.description: How a person signs in. Absent: a private server older than this field, which pairs its devices with a code shown by the server, exactly as `pairing`. Additional properties may appear later and must be ignored.

emailCode.description: An e-mail address, then a code of six digits received by e-mail. Where spaces are open, an address without a space gets one at its first successful verification (`spaceCreation: open`). On a private server (additive, apiVersion 1) only its owner's address signs in, to its one space; any other address is refused with `not_owner`, and before the installation every address with `not_initialized` (`spaceCreation: closed`). A client that knows only `open` reads `closed` as `open`: the refusals then tell the person. Routes: POST /v1/sign-in/code and POST /v1/sign-in/verify (sign-in.schema.json).

spaceCreation.description: `open`: the service creates a space for any new address. `closed`: a private server, one space, its owner's.

termsUrl.description: The terms of use shown at creation. Absent while the service has none configured. When the service names a page per language, this is the default language's (English) page: see `termsUrlTemplate`.

privacyUrl.description: The privacy policy shown at creation. Absent while the service has none configured. When the service names a page per language, this is the default language's (English) page: see `privacyUrlTemplate`.

termsUrlTemplate.description: Additive. Present only when the service names a terms page per language (ASTRO_PORTAL_TERMS_URL holding `{lang}`): the address with `{lang}` as the placeholder of the language tag (`fr`, `ja`, `zh-Hans`, `pt-BR`, the tags of the locale registry). A client replaces it with the tag of the language it is shown in, English when it has none of the registry's; a client that does not know the field opens `termsUrl`.

privacyUrlTemplate.description: Additive. The same as `termsUrlTemplate`, for the privacy policy (ASTRO_PORTAL_PRIVACY_URL).

pairing.description: A private server signing in by password (ASTRO_PORTAL_AUTH_MODE=password): one space, created at installation. A device is attached with the QR code or the eight-character code its account page shows (POST /v1/devices/claim). No e-mail address is asked of the device.

none.description: A service whose private API is switched off (ASTRO_PORTAL_AUTH_MODE=disabled): nothing can be attached to it; the public catalogue and weather routes still answer.
